DevicePage.title: Phone features
DevicePage.description: What this phone can do, each with a working example. Every feature asks for its permission when it needs it, and says what to do when it's missing.
DevicePage.biometrics_text: Check who's holding the phone with its fingerprint or face scanner.
DevicePage.shake_text: Notice a shake and react to it.
DevicePage.motion_text: Accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer and a compass.
DevicePage.camera_text: Take a photo or pick one, then upload it to your files.
DevicePage.scanner_text: Read codes with the camera, and make your own QR code.
DevicePage.location_text: Where the phone is, once or as it moves.
DevicePage.notifications_text: Notify now, or in a few seconds even if the app is closed.
DevicePage.info_text: Model, system, battery, network and screen.
DevicePage.share_text: The share sheet, links, email, calls and the clipboard.

BiometricsPage.title: Fingerprint and face
BiometricsPage.description: Check who's holding the phone with its fingerprint or face scanner, with the device passcode as a fallback. Nothing leaves the phone: it only tells the app yes or no.
BiometricsPage.result_locked_out: Too many attempts. Unlock the phone with its passcode first.
BiometricsPage.result_not_available: Set up a fingerprint, face or passcode in the phone's settings first.
BiometricsPage.result_error: The check didn't work on this device.
BiometricsPage.face_note: Face scan is Face ID on an iPhone, and face unlock on Android phones where it counts as a strong biometric. Elsewhere the prompt offers the fingerprint or the passcode.
BiometricsPage.lock_text: Ask for your {method} whenever the app opens or comes back after a while.

ShakePage.title: Shake
ShakePage.description: The accelerometer notices a firm shake. The app uses it to open the quick menu; here you can watch it work and tune it.
ShakePage.count: {count, plural, =0 {No shakes yet} one {# shake} other {# shakes}}
ShakePage.sensitivity_hint: Lower notices gentler shakes. The quick menu uses 2.7 g.
ShakePage.quick_text: When on, a shake anywhere else in the app opens the quick menu. It is paused on this screen.

MotionPage.title: Motion sensors
MotionPage.description: Raw readings from the motion sensors, and a compass worked out from the magnetometer. They pause when you leave this screen, to save battery.
MotionPage.compass_hint: Hold the phone flat, away from metal.
MotionPage.heading: {degrees}° {direction}

CameraPage.title: Camera and photos
CameraPage.description: Take a photo or pick one from the library, look at it, then send it to your files.
CameraPage.permission_note: The first time, the phone asks to allow the camera or the photo library. If you said no, allow it in the Settings app.

ScannerPage.title: QR and barcode scanner
ScannerPage.description: Point the camera at a QR code or a barcode. The scan stays on the phone.
ScannerPage.error_permission: Allow camera access to scan codes.

LocationPage.title: Location
LocationPage.description: Where the phone is, from GPS, Wi-Fi and cell towers. The position stays on the phone.
LocationPage.follow_hint: Updates as you move, and stops when you leave this screen.
LocationPage.service_off: Location services are off on this phone.
LocationPage.denied_forever: Location is blocked for this app. Allow it in the Settings app.

HapticsPage.title: Haptics
HapticsPage.description: Taps you can feel. Use them to confirm an action, not to decorate.
HapticsPage.disabled: Haptic feedback is off in Settings.
HapticsPage.hint: Simulators, and phones without a vibration motor, feel nothing.

DeviceNotificationsPage.title: Notifications
DeviceNotificationsPage.description: Notifications the app shows by itself, without a server. Push notifications need a service such as Firebase Cloud Messaging; see docs/device-features.md.
DeviceNotificationsPage.default_body: A new mark went on your card.
DeviceNotificationsPage.later_hint: Lock the phone or leave the app to see it arrive.
DeviceNotificationsPage.denied: Notifications are off for this app. Allow them in the Settings app.

DeviceInfoPage.title: Device and battery
DeviceInfoPage.description: What the app knows about the phone it runs on.

SharePage.title: Share and open
SharePage.description: Hand things to other apps: the share sheet, the browser, email, phone calls, texts and the clipboard.
SharePage.share_text_value: I keep my test results on Marksheet.
SharePage.cant_open: No app on this phone can open that.
